import csv, json
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
# Supply run_dir (original workflow output) and csv_path (a new sibling file).
runs = json.loads((run_dir / 'experiment/runs.json').read_bytes())
analysis = json.loads((run_dir / 'analysis/analysis.json').read_bytes())
fields = ['split_seed','condition','evaluation_split','sample_id','target','prediction']
with csv_path.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as stream:
    writer=csv.DictWriter(stream,fieldnames=fields); writer.writeheader()
    for run in runs:
        for condition in run['conditions']:
            for part in ('validation','test'):
                for item in condition[part]['predictions']:
                    writer.writerow(dict(split_seed=run['split_seed'],condition=condition['condition'],evaluation_split=part,**item))
with csv_path.open(encoding='utf-8',newline='') as stream:
    records=list(csv.DictReader(stream))
assert len(records)==864
by_group=defaultdict(dict)
for row in records:
    key=(int(row['split_seed']),row['condition'],row['evaluation_split'])
    sample_id=int(row['sample_id']); assert sample_id not in by_group[key]
    by_group[key][sample_id]=(int(row['target']),int(row['prediction']))
assert len(by_group)==18
recount_rows=[]
for (seed,condition,part),pairs in sorted(by_group.items()):
    correct=sum(target==prediction for target,prediction in pairs.values())
    assert len(pairs)==48
    stored=next(c[part] for r in runs if r['split_seed']==seed for c in r['conditions'] if c['condition']==condition)
    derived=next(x for x in analysis['descriptive_rows'] if x['split_seed']==seed and x['condition']==condition and x['evaluation_split']==part)
    assert stored['n']==derived['n']==len(pairs)
    assert stored['correct']==derived['correct']==correct
    assert stored['accuracy']==derived['accuracy']==correct/len(pairs)
    recount_rows.append(dict(split_seed=seed,condition=condition,evaluation_split=part,n=len(pairs),correct=correct,accuracy=correct/len(pairs)))
a=by_group[(11,'raw_1nn','test')]; b=by_group[(11,'scaled_1nn','test')]
assert set(a)==set(b)
gained=lost=both_correct=both_wrong=0
for sample_id,(target,prediction) in a.items():
    other_target,other_prediction=b[sample_id]; assert target==other_target
    ac=target==prediction; bc=target==other_prediction
    gained += not ac and bc; lost += ac and not bc
    both_correct += ac and bc; both_wrong += not ac and not bc
independent_pairing=dict(n_pairs=len(a),gained=gained,lost=lost,both_correct=both_correct,both_wrong=both_wrong,point_difference_pp=(gained-lost)/len(a)*100)
assert abs(independent_pairing['point_difference_pp']-analysis['paired_bootstrap']['point_difference_pp'])<1e-12
